name: Look To The Stars
summary: Viktori Prism'Antras needs one final piece for his telescope in Darkshire. Its frame is built, but no local glass is large enough for the lens his plans require.

sections.title: The Final Piece
sections.body: Viktori Prism'Antras is building a telescope in Darkshire from plans by the gnome engineer Cog Glitzspinner. He has gathered brass tubes and sturdy mountings from local supplies, but the design calls for an unusually large focusing lens. Magnifying glasses and optical parts from Stormwind traders are too small, so Viktori looks beyond ordinary materials for the piece he needs.

sections.title: The Ogre's Eyepiece
sections.body: Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in the shadow of the southern hills, crowded with hostile ogres. Zzarc'Vul, one of them, wears a glass monocle large enough for Viktori's telescope. Taking it from Zzarc'Vul would give Viktori the lens Cog's plans call for, letting him finish the telescope and look into the heavens above Duskwood's shadowed canopy.

faq.answer: Viktori Prism'Antras is an astronomer and scholar who lives in a hut up the hill in Darkshire. Though Duskwood lies under a gloom, he remains devoted to finishing his telescope and studying the stars.
Zzarc'Vul is in Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood. He roams the camp and cave network, among heavily guarded ogre territory.

faq.q: Why does an ogre possess a monocle?
faq.answer: Zzarc'Vul wears an oversized monocle. It is the only lens in the region large enough to fit Cog's telescope plans.

faq.q: What happens once the device is completed?
faq.answer: The monocle lets Viktori fit the telescope's final lens. Once the device is complete, he can return to studying the stars above the bleak forest.
Cog, a gnome engineer, designed the telescope. His plans call for specialized parts, a metal frame, and a lens far larger than standard dwarven or gnomish spectacles.

faq.q: Is Vul'Gol Ogre Mound safe to enter alone?
faq.answer: No. Hostile ogres fill Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, patrolling in packs and guarding narrow paths. Searching deep inside for Zzarc'Vul is dangerous for a lone traveler.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see Darkshire endure against the horrors and beasts around it. Viktori's pursuit of the stars offers a small sign of civilian perseverance.
As a gnome, you know ingenuity can turn an unlikely find into a useful part. Viktori's telescope plans call for a lens taken from an ogre's monocle.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the audacity of using a massive ogre monocle to meet the demands of an astronomical lens.
